author: H4RBINGER_
quote: ARC Raiders stands as this year's paramount multiplayer achievement—a distilled extraction shooter that streamlines genre conventions without sacrificing depth, its formidable AI challenge and immersive atmosphere masking any superficial simplicity. This live service title delivers gratification in equal measure whether experienced alongside companions or in solitary ventures. The PvPvE architecture proves exceptionally compelling and viscerally rewarding; remarkably, despite its scant fortnight in the wild, the game perpetually **** its concurrent user benchmarks week after week. Equally commendable is the studio's adaptive stewardship—calibrating balance iterations in direct response to community discourse. The prospect of forthcoming content expansions commands genuine anticipation.

author: H4RBINGER_
quote: Your opinion of this game can vary greatly depending on how high your expectations are. While Call of Duty, which lost its identity with the cosmetic products introduced in Black Ops 6 multiplayer, promises that the cosmetics in the new game will be more grounded and won't stray from the game's identity, the story mode gives us a major clue about what awaits us in the future. While its biggest competitor released a grounded, acclaimed, and enjoyable game this year, playing this game in its current state would be pure torture.
